_doc: Board configuration for copperpath (--cfg). Every key is optional; without --cfg every net
with at least two pads is routed on every copper layer of the board.
Keys may sit at the top level, or per board under "boards": {"<name>": {...}} (pick one
with --board <name>; without --board the first entry is used). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
skip_classes        net classes that are not routed (e.g. classes poured as planes)
skip_nets           nets that are not routed
planes              plane nets (strings or {"net": ...}); never routed
via_keepout_refs    footprints whose courtyard forbids vias
class_layers        allowed copper layers per net class
layer_dir           preferred direction per layer for the global router (H or V)
mounting_hole_refs  reference pattern of mounting holes (default MH*)
yield_pours         locked pours (zone name wildcards) that do not block routing (KiCad refills them)
